# Date.DaysInMonth

```m
Date.DaysInMonth(dateTime as any) as nullable number
```

Returns a number from 28 to 31 indicating the number of days in the month.

*Description: Microsoft, MIT ([THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md](../../../../THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md)).*
